thread:
Nora: Heads-up from design review: the help flyout uses 'policy mappings' while docs and SDK call it 'policy rules'. Clicks to 'Read docs' land people at the top of the page instead of the specific section.

Keven: Oof. We should pick one canonical term. SDK telemetry uses policy_rule so my vote: 'policy rule'.

Priya: Agreed. For the flyout header we can use 'Rules' and in help copy 'Policy rule' to be explicit. Also the link text 'Read docs' is ambiguous for screen readers.

Sam: Dev note: console sends /docs/policy not /docs/policy#rules. Our SPA sometimes strips hashes on navigation. Use absolute URLs with hashes and ensure docs router preserves and scrolls to the id.

Lila: Accessibility: external links need rel="noopener" and aria-label like 'Policy rules docs (opens in new tab)'. For tight UI use visually-hidden text rather than cluttering the visible label.

Nora: UX copy proposal: flyout title 'Rules', line copy 'Policy rule — a rule that routes requests based on metadata. Read policy rules (opens in new tab)'. Keven: ok?

Keven: Works. Also add alias anchors on docs for #policy-mappings to point to #policy-rules with a note about the rename so old bookmarks don't break.

Priya: I'll update Figma tokens: label.short.policy = 'Rules' and label.long.policy = 'Policy rule'. Also add an externalAccessibilityLabel token.

Sam: Implementation checklist: 1) Console: link -> full URL + hash, target=_blank rel=noopener noreferrer, aria-label from token. 2) Docs: preserve hash on route mount and run focus utility: set tabindex=-1; scrollIntoView({block:'start'}); focus({preventScroll:true}). 3) Add e2e keyboard test that opens flyout, tabs to link, activates, and asserts focus on docs anchor.

Lila: Accessibility test note: when focusing the anchor, account for sticky headers by offsetting scroll by header height. Also ensure the visually-hidden text is readable by AT.

Nora: Owners? Priya for design tokens + copy (ETA 2d), Sam for console change + e2e (ETA 3d), Keven for docs alias + router fix (ETA 2d). I'll do a11y review after PRs.

docs-bot: Created task #6001: "Harmonize 'policy mappings' -> 'policy rules' across console and docs; add alias anchors and a11y labels" assigned to Priya, Sam, Keven.

Nora: Thanks team. After merges let's do a short pairing session with VoiceOver and NVDA to confirm behavior. :thumbsup:
